hostOnlyTestDispositions.note: The case was added only in this migration worktree (uncommitted `git diff` on HEAD), so it was never a committed governed requirement. It asserted the retired host copy. The live module covers the same transition from the other direction: agent-browser-runtime-mode.test.ts "降级回 normal_restricted 清理过期时间" asserts that after the runtime mode drops back to normal_restricted, actions are rejected again, and service.revokeFullAccessRuntime() performs that same runtimeMode transition (plus a grant-context clear). What is no longer separately asserted is the literal fullAccessRevoke entry point followed by a denial. Recorded as a residual gap, not claimed as covered; closing it would need an upstream test added to the pinned source repo, not a private edit here (M09 pins module tests byte-for-byte to the source repo).
